page: Microsoft Azure E96bs_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine engineered for enterprise applications requiring substantial memory allocations and parallel processing power. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. The instance provides 96 vCPUs derived from 48 dedicated physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity totals 672.0 GB of RAM, yielding 7.0 GB of memory per vCPU. Cache provisioning includes 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate top-quartile parallel throughput across multi-core tests, registering 93261.33 on stress-ng multi-core and 17571.0 on Geekbench multi-core. Single-core evaluations, including a stress-ng score of 1899.69 and a Geekbench score of 1708.0, position the server within the middle 50% tier. Memory sub-systems exhibit high read bandwidth at 329.85 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 135.97 GB/sec on large 256 MB block transfers. PassMark metrics indicate strong database operations at 30801.84 alongside a top-tier CPU encryption rating of 87561.74. In-memory performance is further verified by Redis SET throughput reaching 86.58 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput measures 63.12 GB/sec.

Architecturally, the E96bs_v5 includes no attached local storage and contains no discrete graphics hardware accelerators. All persistent storage must be attached via remote block volumes, specifically utilizing Azure Premium Storage capabilities. Network deployment also requires provisioning separate external routing, as complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not bundled.

From an efficiency standpoint, the VM represents a concentrated deployment of high-density compute and memory resources. Workloads requiring significant parallel multi-threading and rapid memory throughput gain high utilization from the 48-core baseline, though applications bound strictly to per-core single-threaded latency may see lower comparative value. The configuration is specifically tailored for in-memory databases, large-scale relational database engines, high-volume transactional systems, and data analytics pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E96bs_v5 is a memory-optimized instance featuring 96 vCPUs backed by 48 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor clocked at 2.8 GHz. Designed for intensive operational environments, it incorporates 672.0 GB of RAM (7.0 GB per core) and a 48 MB L3 cache, supporting AVX-512 and hardware cryptographic instructions. The instance contains no integrated local storage or GPUs, relying on external Premium Storage volumes. Multi-core performance is top-tier, evidenced by strong PassMark CPU, memory, and database scores, paired with a Redis throughput of 86.58 million SET operations per second. While single-thread benchmarks land in the middle tier, the high parallel throughput and extensive RAM make it suited for large relational databases, in-memory data structures, caching layers, and high-concurrency enterprise workloads.
